meta.description: Implementation contract locking in all deterministic Python execution details before generating outcome statistics. Restores previously approved precise computational semantics.

01_ic_and_preprocessing.icSignal: 02 and 05 IC calculations一律使用 raw eligible signal (no winsor/ECDF). rank(method='average'). Pension uses only eligible rebalance rows.
01_ic_and_preprocessing.oosPreprocessing: 03/04 OOS preprocessing strictly follows signal registry per-module. VC/RP/CTA use TRAIN-only winsor -> TRAIN ECDF. Pension (transform: none / winsor: none) remains unchanged.
01_ic_and_preprocessing.insufficientVariationPolicy: If standard deviation is zero, evaluation folds fail closed (insufficient_training_variation).

02_partial_rank_ic.sample: Strict complete-case intersection of (S, Y, momentum, vol).
02_partial_rank_ic.procedure: rank(method='average') for all 4. OLS residualization with intercept. Then correlation.
02_partial_rank_ic.gate: sign(partialIC) == expectedDirection. 0 or NaN/undefined directly FAIL. No extra significance gate required.

03_moving_block_bootstrap.procedure: Sort by firstTradableSession then decisionDate. Construct all continuous overlapping blocks of length L. Sample with replacement, concatenate, truncate to N. DO NOT circular wrap.
03_moving_block_bootstrap.separation: 02 bootstraps Spearman IC. 04 bootstraps mean loss differential (d_t). The passes must not be mixed.

04_hac_definitions.singleFactor: rank(Y) = alpha + beta * rank(S). Two-sided HAC test on beta=0.
04_hac_definitions.oosLoss: intercept-only regression: d_t = alpha + epsilon_t. Two-sided HAC test on alpha=0.

05_oos_fold_semantics.fitFrequency: Parameters fit strictly once per testYear per primary hypothesis.
05_oos_fold_semantics.purge: Horizon-specific lastLabelSession < first tradable test session.
05_oos_fold_semantics.sample: Baseline and enhanced models use exact same train/test common sample.
05_oos_fold_semantics.trainingStats: Baseline mean/std, signal winsor thresholds, ECDF computed strictly on train.
05_oos_fold_semantics.baselineTiming: t = last completed ^GSPC session strictly before F (firstTradableSession). Never F close.
05_oos_fold_semantics.deduplication: Multiple decision rows with the same firstTradableSession MUST NOT be artificially deduplicated.

06_oos_formal_gate.pooledTest: Test applied EXACTLY ONCE on the pooled OOS predictions across all test years.
06_oos_formal_gate.confirmatoryMetrics: Delta MAE > 0 is calculated and reported as confirmatory ONLY. Delta R2 is descriptive ONLY. Neither can override the squared-error gate.

07_fail_closed_and_family.regime: 05 uses raw-Spearman. N_total counts ONLY eligible years (N >= 30). LOYO drops one eligible year and recomputes aggregate IC.
07_fail_closed_and_family.fdrFamily: Strictly 8 primary hypotheses. Invalid/insufficient (N < 60, constant signal, undefined rho/HAC) -> effective p = 1.0, hypothesis_pass = false. MUST NOT be removed from BH family.
07_fail_closed_and_family.evidenceGate: 07 reads ONLY primary results. Secondary results strictly for display. Output is SUPPORTED or NOT_SUPPORTED.
